title: C: Simple Interpreter (Simulated)
description: Build a simple expression interpreter that parses and evaluates arithmetic expressions with +, -, *, /, and parentheses.

steps.title: Expression Parser (Recursive Descent)
steps.description: Write a recursive descent parser for expressions: `int expr(char **p)` parses addition/subtraction, `int term(char **p)` parses multiplication/division, `int factor(char **p)` parses numbers and parentheses. Parse and evaluate '3+4*2'.
